info.name: AutomationExercise API
info.description: Automation Exercise 公開 14 支 API 測試集合（軟體測試大作業 3.2）。匯入後請建立/選擇環境變數 baseUrl=https://automationexercise.com，再用 Collection Runner 一次跑完並截圖。備註：API 一律回 HTTP 200，真正狀態碼在回應 JSON 的 responseCode 欄位，故斷言驗證 body.responseCode 與 message。

item.name: API 1 - 取得所有商品清單 (GET productsList)

exec: let json; try { json = pm.response.json(); } catch(e) { json = {}; }
pm.test('responseCode 為 200', () => pm.expect(json.responseCode).to.eql(200));
pm.test('回應含 products 陣列', () => pm.expect(json.products).to.be.an('array'));

item.name: API 2 - POST 商品清單 (不支援, 405)

exec: let json; try { json = pm.response.json(); } catch(e) { json = {}; }

pm.test('訊息: 不支援此方法', () => pm.expect(json.message).to.include('not supported'));

item.name: API 6 - 搜尋商品 (缺少參數, 400)

exec: let json; try { json = pm.response.json(); } catch(e) { json = {}; }
pm.test('responseCode 為 400', () => pm.expect(json.responseCode).to.eql(400));
pm.test('訊息: 缺少 search_product 參數', () => pm.expect(json.message).to.include('search_product parameter is missing'));
const ts = Date.now();
pm.environment.set('userEmail', 'qa_' + ts + '@example.com');
pm.environment.set('userPassword', 'Test@12345');
pm.environment.set('userName', 'QA Tester');
let json; try { json = pm.response.json(); } catch(e) { json = {}; }
pm.test('responseCode 為 201', () => pm.expect(json.responseCode).to.eql(201));
pm.test('訊息: User created!', () => pm.expect(json.message).to.eql('User created!'));
let json; try { json = pm.response.json(); } catch(e) { json = {}; }
pm.test('responseCode 為 200', () => pm.expect(json.responseCode).to.eql(200));
pm.test('訊息: User exists!', () => pm.expect(json.message).to.eql('User exists!'));
